name: Marco Cables & Conductors Ltd.
summary: Marco Cables & Conductors Ltd., an Indian enterprise, specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of various electrical wiring, cabling, and conductor products. Its primary offerings encompass Low Tension (LT) XLPE and PVC cables, as well as Aerial Bunched Cables, all essential for power distribution networks. Furthermore, the company produces transmission conductors, including All Aluminium Alloy Conductors (AAAC) and Aluminium Conductor Steel Reinforced (ACSR) types. Its clientele predominantly comprises state electricity distribution boards and EPC contractors active in the power infrastructure sector. The firm's entire revenue is generated from the sale of these manufactured goods, with its central production facility situated in Nashik, Maharashtra.
